prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one 2x2 transparent mascot atlas for a Chinese INK WASH AND PAPER CUT game, strictly flat folk-art, NOT 3D cute app mascots. Four equal square quadrants, each with a single isolated full-body animal entirely INSIDE its quadrant with 12% transparent padding on ALL sides. Top left: adorable baby deer with big rounded head, short legs, forked antlers, small red scarf, lively jumping pose, warm ochre cut paper with ivory negative-space belly and maple motifs. Top right: plump smiling baby whale, teal paper body, ivory belly, small fins, tail raised, tiny simple ink water spray. Bottom left: round baby crane spreading short cut-paper wings, ivory paper, charcoal feather blocks, vermilion crown and long golden tiny beak, plump cute bird proportions. Bottom right: sitting baby white fox with enormous curled cut-paper tail, pointed ears, small blue scarf, tiny paws, ivory and grey-blue ink. ALL animals have expressive simple BLACK INK eyes with ONE tiny matte white dot, curved smiling mouths, minimal vermilion cheek mark. Art direction: authentic contemporary Chinese traditional jianzhi paper-cut crossed with sumi-e ink painting, crisp scissor-cut silhouettes, broad matte gouache color fields, visible fibrous xuan paper texture, limited palette of ink charcoal, ivory rice paper, vermilion, muted ochre, muted teal and indigo; dry-brush ink edge accents and tasteful traditional cloud/leaf cutout motifs. Cute through oversized heads, soft round silhouettes and playful poses. Absolutely FLAT illustration: NO gradients, NO volumetric shading, NO lighting highlights, NO shiny eyes, NO glassy eyes, NO glossy gold, NO plush fur, NO realistic feather detail, NO plastic, NO 3D render, NO anime eyelashes, NO jewelry. No scenery, UI, labels, text, borders, ground shadow. Background truly transparent. Elegant handmade folk-art game style, strong readable silhouettes.
